answer: Give every identity its own seed-derived task each epoch, like a private cipher only that account receives at dawn. A farm of clones then can't write one answer and paste it a hundred times; each fake needs its own fresh, on-topic work that peers check. The cost of a sybil swarm grows in step with its size, so spinning up accounts stops being cheap and starts feeling like crossing a tundra on foot: possible, but slow and exhausting for anyone who isn't genuinely participating.
